scope: Mapped-state correspondence and combinational next-state/output equivalence; not RTL-to-gates or physical verification
method: Corresponding Q values are shared arbitrary inputs; compare every D/CLK/reset/set input and top output. Cell types and port directions must match.
negative_control: Deliberate inversion of status[0] rejected by the same SAT comparison
limitations: Two-state Boolean equivalence under matched arbitrary register state; no X/metastability/glitch/timing proof.
Compares selected mapped artifacts, not original behavioral RTL against gates.
All mapped register cell types/parameters and input pins are compared; equivalent initial state correspondence is required.
No placement, wire parasitics, clock/reset physical distribution or analog qualification.
harness_correction: Negative control initially exposed inconsistent port/net-name wiring; generator now checks these agree and mutates both. Corrected positive and negative checks both rerun.
